ruleDefinitions.name: LOLBAS Data Exfiltration by DataSvcUtil.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user performs data exfiltration by using DataSvcUtil.exe

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/in\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/out\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/uri\\:.*")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\DataSvcUtil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "DataSvcUtil\.exe"))
